curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the National Driver Register check and the main offenses that cost a license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the register check and license-loss offenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on problem driver checks and offenses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover medical, criminal and under-eighteen grounds for losing a license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each further ground, including the school rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on further grounds for losing a license.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain surrendering a license, hearings, address changes and the violator compact.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on surrender, hearings, address and the compact.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on surrender, notice and address rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how points build up and the thresholds for adults and juveniles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on point thresholds, the course and reinstatement.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: List the points each violation carries, from speeding to passing a stopped bus.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each violation's point value.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who can get a restricted license and the medical review rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on restricted license types and medical reports.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on restricted licenses and medical rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the insurance types and the Financial Responsibility Law.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on insurance types and proof of responsibility.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on insurance and financial responsibility.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover what to do at a crash, how to report it, and how to pass one safely.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on crash reporting and crash scene steps.
